# Sakartvelo Exchange

> A privatization simulation running on Arbitrum One. Every citizen receives the same 1,000 INVEST and bids it for shares in state companies in open hourly auctions. Once half of a company is sold, its shareholders elect a CEO for 30 days, and nothing leaves the company without a shareholder vote. The process is real and public on-chain; the companies are fictional. INVEST is given free and has no value when issued.

The site is available in English and Georgian (ქართული). Pages are rendered in the browser and read live data from the contracts.

## Pages

- [Register](https://www.sakartvelo-exchange.com/): all listed companies, their auction stage, shares sold and capital
- [Citizenship](https://www.sakartvelo-exchange.com/citizen): verify a wallet (it must hold at least 0.0083 ETH on Arbitrum One; nothing is taken) and claim 1,000 INVEST, once per wallet
- [Rules](https://www.sakartvelo-exchange.com/rules): the rules the contracts enforce, in plain words
- [White paper](https://www.sakartvelo-exchange.com/whitepaper): the idea behind the simulation
- [Market](https://www.sakartvelo-exchange.com/market): shares listed for sale by their holders
- [Portfolio](https://www.sakartvelo-exchange.com/portfolio): look up the shares, votes and roles of any address

## Key rules

- Auctions: up to 150 shares a round, one-hour rounds with a one-hour pause between them. Everyone in a round pays the same clearing price. 99% of what is paid becomes company capital, 1% goes to the host.
- Elections open at 50% of shares sold. A CEO wins with yes votes from 20% of the electorate and 51% of votes cast; shareholders can vote to remove the CEO.
- Treasury: every payment, sale or investment is a shareholder proposal with a 5-day delay before it runs. At most 20% of a bucket can be spent per term.
- New citizens: at most 50 an hour.
